name: cms-local-runtime
description: Manual eval cases for the local CMS backend runtime skill.
warning: These evals start and stop the local Tomcat instance at C:\Tomcat 9.0. Do not run blindly on a shared environment.
passCriteria: The assistant uses the cms-local-runtime skill for local backend start/stop requests.
The Start-Process startup command is the final tool call.
After the Start-Process tool call returns, the assistant immediately sends the final response.
No healthcheck, file read, todo/status update, or extra command runs after the startup Start-Process call unless explicitly requested before startup.
CAPTCHA is disabled only when explicitly requested for that startup.
If CAPTCHA was disabled for startup, stop flow restores both CAPTCHA flags to true in src/main/webapp/WEB-INF/web.xml.

cases.name: normal-startup
expected: Do not set CAPTCHA flags to false.
Final response is exactly or effectively: Az alkalmazás elindult.
failIf: Direct catalina.bat start invocation is used instead of Start-Process.
Any tool call runs after Start-Process.
The prompt is not returned immediately after startup.

cases.name: startup-with-captcha-disabled
cases.prompt: indítsd el az alkalmazást kikapcsolt captcha-val
expected: Final response is exactly or effectively: Az alkalmazás elindult. Captcha kikapcsolva.
failIf: CAPTCHA remains enabled in source before build.
Direct catalina.bat start invocation is used instead of Start-Process.
Any tool call runs after Start-Process.
The prompt is not returned immediately after startup.

cases.name: stop-after-captcha-disabled-startup
cases.precondition: The most recent startup explicitly disabled CAPTCHA.
expected: Stop Tomcat with C:\Tomcat 9.0\bin\catalina.bat stop using local Tomcat env vars.
failIf: The stop flow leaves either CAPTCHA flag as false.

cases.name: stop-after-normal-startup
cases.precondition: The most recent startup did not explicitly disable CAPTCHA.
expected: Stop Tomcat with C:\Tomcat 9.0\bin\catalina.bat stop using local Tomcat env vars.
Do not change CAPTCHA flags unless they are unexpectedly false and the user asks to restore them.

cases.name: ambiguous-captcha-mention
cases.prompt: indítsd el az alkalmazást, a captcha állapotát ne piszkáld
expected: Start with detached Start-Process as the final tool call.
Final response is exactly or effectively: Az alkalmazás elindult.
failIf: CAPTCHA is disabled just because the prompt mentions CAPTCHA.
